title: In Emotional Attachment To Maya, All
summary: Sangat is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled; is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him
lifeApplication: Move closer to one company that helps the heart tell the truth. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
